title: AI Business Analyst
description:
**Role Overview:** 




  





 We are seeking an AI Business Analyst to drive the identification, definition, and end\-to\-end implementation of AI use cases across International Wealth Management (IWM). The successful candidate will act as the bridge between wealth management stakeholders and AI delivery teams; translating business pain points into prioritized, feasible, and value generating AI solutions.
 



  





**Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required:** 




  





**Essential:** 



* Previous experience working within Wealth Management (International/Private Banking preferred), Wholesale Banking, or Asset Management
* Proven experience delivering AI or ML model implementations in financial institutions — ideally taking use cases from concept through to production adoption
* Strong understanding of the International Wealth Management landscape, including advisory/discretionary models, client segments, and the front\-to\-back advisor workflow
* Working knowledge of financial products (e.g., derivatives, structured products, funds) relevant to wealth management portfolios
* Demonstrable ability to identify, frame, and prioritize AI/analytics use cases and articulate them as Use Cases and User Stories
* Expertise in data lineage and data quality standards
* Strength in conceptual modelling — able to see the big picture, envision solution options, and provide concise, precise, managerial answers across a wide range of business topics
* Strong experience documenting BRDs and requirements artifacts
* Ability to engage senior stakeholders and manage cross\-functional projects across business areas, functions, and locations
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar delivery tooling
* Ability to work under limited supervision (a "self\-starter") in unstructured, ambiguous environments
* Intellectual strength and flexibility to rapidly understand complex problems and rationalize them into deliverable solutions
* High level of drive, commitment to outcomes, and ability to perform under pressure
* Familiarity with delivery methodologies, particularly Agile
* Experience working with technology teams to deliver complex solutions across multiple business areas, functions, and locations



  





**Desirable:** 



* Business Analysis Certification (e.g., CBAP)
* Familiarity with modern AI/GenAI capabilities and their practical application in wealth management (e.g., LLM\-based advisor tooling, document summarization, client insights)
* Awareness of AI governance and responsible\-AI frameworks in a regulated financial services context
* Exposure to cross\-border / multi\-jurisdictional wealth management operations

title: Avaloq Business Analyst
description:
**Key Responsibilities and objectives critical to success:** 




  




* Drive the transformation of client buying power (based on client available collateral) checks from manual, end\-of\-day processes to real\-time, automated solutions across multiple trading platforms and asset classes.
* Gather and analyse complex business requirements from trading desks, credit teams, and execution platforms.
* Analyse current manual buying power calculation processes and design future\-state processes for real\-time buying power checks across trading platforms.
* Document detailed business specifications for the buying power utility integration. Map data requirements across source systems (Avaloq, LTV systems, execution platforms)
* Scope the Avaloq system: Work closely together with the Product Owner and other functions to ensure right granularity of requirements specification on an epic / story level.
* Translate business needs: Create models, diagrams, presentations, and other documentations that support the target audience to understand the business requirements.
* Facilitate communication at team level to create consensus on scope, design decisions, and implementation decisions.
* Validate requirements, UAT Testing \& User training (if required), validate e2e requirements via reviews, walkthroughs, and demo. Write \& conduct UAT test cases and in case required, train stakeholders.
* Proactively identify risks/issues that might affect project health.
* Experience in functional analysis in area of Private Banking, Wealth Management; Knowledge and experience of banking business and its operations is a big plus.
* Establish and maintain project management standards, processes, and best practices, ensuring that projects are executed efficiently.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to adapt approach to stakeholder groups and different levels of seniority across the organization as well as ability to present complex problems in a simple way to drive quick and effective decision making.



  





**Skills, experience, qualifications and knowledge required:** 




  





**Essential:** 



* Knowledge of LTV (Loan\-to\-Value) calculations and concentration risk management. Previous experience with buying power, margin, or credit limit systems.
* Experience with API\-based integrations
* Strong understanding of trading operations, client onboarding, and credit management processes
* Strong experience with Avaloq Core Platform (Modules\- STEX, Credit, Client Data, MIS reports, Stock exchange, and payments); Avaloq certification is a plus.
* Previous experience working within Wealth Management, Wholesale Banking or Asset Management
* Strong understanding of the Wealth Management landscape
* Strong experience in documenting BRDs so that the candidate can contribute to drafting Business Process Change document, Policies \& Procedure updates etc. from business operationalization aspect.
* Expertise in conceptual modelling, ability to see the big picture and envision possible solutions and clear ability to provide concise, precise, and managerial answers to a wide array of business\-related topics.
* Previous experience with Jira, Confluence, Power BI, or similar tools
* Ability to work under limited supervision (‘self\-starter’) in unstructured environments.
* Intellectual strength / flexibility to rapidly understand complex problems and rationalize these into a workable solution which can then be delivered.
* High level of drive, commitment to achieving solutions and ability to work under pressure.
* Familiarity with different delivery methodologies (particularly Agile)
* Familiarity experience articulating requirements in the form of Use Case, User Stories
* Experience working with technology teams to deliver complex solutions across multiple business areas, functions, and locations.

title: Process Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Tableau Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be a self\-driven individual with a deep understanding of data visualization, business intelligence, and data modeling best practices. This role requires extensive expertise in Tableau, calculated KPI, proficient SQL window functions, and the ability to design and deliver robust, user\-friendly dashboards, including those with complex visualizations and integrated machine learning models. The successful candidate will also possess strong analytical skills to translate business requirements into technical specifications and collaborate effectively with data engineering teams, all while working independently of generative AI tools
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain interactive and visually appealing Tableau dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights to business stakeholders.
* Develop complex calculated formulas and measures to create sophisticated calculations and aggregations within Tableau models.
* Proficiently apply various SQL window functions (e.g., ROW\_NUMBER (), RANK (), LAG (), LEAD (), NTILE (), Loop, etc.) to transform and prepare data for Tableau consumption.
* Lead and execute data modeling efforts within Tableau, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and data integrity (e.g., star schema, snowflake schema, relationships, hierarchies).
* Collaborate directly with business users to gather and understand reporting requirements, translating them into technical specifications and compelling dashboard designs.
* Design and implement complex charts and visualizations, including but not limited to Sankey diagrams, Step charts, drill down charts, dynamic charts (dynamic KPI and Dimension using field parameter) where number of charts or kpi’s and dimensions in a chart can be altered to represent intricate data flows and trends.
* Integrate and present outputs from machine learning models within Tableau reports and dashboards.
* Architect and design end\-to\-end Tableau solutions, considering data sources, data transformation, data models, security, and deployment strategies.
* Provide clear and concise data requirements and specifications to data engineers for data ingestion, transformation, and warehousing initiatives.
* Optimize Tableau reports and dashboards for performance; including query optimization, data source connectivity, and visual rendering.
* Perform thorough data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy and reliability of reports.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest Tableau features, industry trends, and best practices.
* Act as a subject matter expert for Tableau within the organization, providing guidance and support to other team members.
* Demonstrate the ability to independently research, analyze, and solve complex problems without reliance on generative AI tools.


**Required Skills and Qualifications:**
* Education: Bachelor degree in Analytics, Data Science, Business, Statistics, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Tableau Developer.
* Demonstrable expertise in data modeling principles and practices within Tableau, including understanding of relationships, cardinality, cross\-filter direction, and custom SQL for data transformation.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including extensive experience with all types of SQL window functions (e.g., analytic, ranking, aggregate, value, distribution functions).
* Experience in integrating outputs from machine learning models into Tableau reports and dashboards.
* Experience working with various data sources (SQL Server, Azure Synapse, Excel, SharePoint, APIs, etc.).
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and provide clear requirements to data engineers.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* A strong commitment to independent work and problem solving, without reliance on generative AI tools.


**Preferred (Bonus) Skills:**
* Experience with Azure data services or Alteryx (Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure SQL Database).
* Experience of data warehousing and ETL processes.
* Hands on Experience of Python for NLP, Deep learning, Computer Vision and Classification Techniques is a plus.
* Experience with other BI tools (e.g., Power BI, QlikView) is a plus.
* Relevant Tableau certifications.
* Experience of working with data that belongs to a process, such as manufacturing, supply chain, or business workflows.


**Soft Skills:**
* Should be a Team player.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and critical\-thinking abilities.
* A proactive and collaborative mindset, with a focus on continuous improvement.

title: Quality Specialist II
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Purpose :** 
 Performs comprehensive quality analysis across region by evaluating performance metrics, trends, and compliance with quality standards. Translates data into actionable insights through structured reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly) to support continuous improvement, operational excellence, and informed decision\-making.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Quality Specialist II with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Quality Analysis \& Insights:
+ Conduct detailed analysis of quality metrics, performance indicators, and trends across projects and regional/global level.
+ Identify patterns, gaps, and improvement opportunities, translating them into actionable insights for leadership.
+ Leverage digital tools and analytics (including AI where relevant) to enhance reporting accuracy, efficiency, and predictive insights.

* Reporting \& Dashboards:
+ Prepare periodical Quality Reports highlighting key trends, performance against targets, root cause insights, and recommended actions.
+ Develop Quality reports and dashboards for business reviews summarizing quality performance, strategic insights, improvement initiatives, and risks/opportunities.
+ Ensure consistency, accuracy, and standardization of reporting formats across regions and functions.

* Stakeholder Engagement:
+ Work closely with business leaders, quality teams, and functional stakeholders to gather inputs and validate insights.
+ Present quality analysis and reports to stakeholders, including leadership forums and governance committees.
+ Facilitate discussions to drive understanding of quality performance and improvement actions.

* Quality Framework \& Continuous Improvement:

description:

 ISS STOXX is seeking

This data feeds our broad suite of ESG solutions, including our market\-leading Corporate Rating.
   

  

**Overview**
 ESG analysts research to evaluate a company's performance areas across the full range of ESG themes, including working conditions, supply chain management, sustainability governance, environmental management, and emission and resource consumption. Daily tasks include reviewing company documents such as sustainability reports, annual reports and corporate websites, and identifying, analysing and processing relevant qualitative and quantitative data in line with ISS ESG’s methodology. Our teams are based in the Philippines, the US, Australia, Germany, Sweden, India, and the UK. The successful candidate will work both independently as well as collaboratively with the local team and colleagues across our global offices. Working in a dynamic market and international environment, we put great emphasis on cooperation and offer a welcoming, collegial working atmosphere.
   

  

 Our analysts stand for research integrity and a thorough methodical approach, paying attention to detail to achieve relevant, accurate and reliable results. Being able to see the big picture as well as critical thinking are considered key factors for success. ISS STOXX ESG offers unique development opportunities for ESG generalists as well as thematic or sector specialists. A career with our ESG Research team allows you to gain in\-depth insight into ESG and sustainable investment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Excellent English language skills, both written and oral

title: MSET QR Corporate Actions_Senior Manager_Institutional Equity Division
description:
**Company Profile**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.
   

  

 As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career \- a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.
   

  

**Department Profile**
 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 The Quantitative Research (QR) group designs, builds and maintains the models which drive the equity trading engines at Morgan Stanley. Our systems are used globally by both internal trading groups and clients of the firm. We utilize systematic, data\-driven approaches to understand how markets work and put those ideas in action. The team spans the disciplines of finance, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, machine learning and data analysis, with many team members well versed in multiple areas. We are looking to hire highly talented, creative individuals who are enthusiastic about research; and enthusiastic about making a contribution to a leading\-edge team, in an intellectually stimulating environment.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 This role, based in Mumbai, requires the individual to work with global Morgan Stanley Quantitative Research teams. The successful candidate will be a fast\-learning, dynamic, pro\-active and self\-motivated individual who can assist the team in maintaining and analyzing referential data, as well as generating ad hoc performance and market condition reports for clients.
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
* Responsible for analyzing ongoing corporate events like M\&As, spin\-offs, bankruptcies, reorganizations, and other corporate actions (e.g., stock splits, rights offerings, dividends, etc.)
* Timely identification and reviewing nature of the corporate action and it’s impact index memberships, weights, size, style, and industry classifications.
* Collaborating globally to deliver timely and high\-quality responses to queries related to corporate events raised by our global clients and internal teams.
* Share insights through emails and presentations by preparing deep\-dive analytical content on corporate actions, index events, and market microstructure.
* Collaborate regularly with cross\-functional teams including Sales, Trading, and Strats.


**Core Requirements**
 We are looking for a confident and outgoing individual, who has exceptional attention to detail and takes initiative.
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in the financial sector with direct practical experience in equity markets
* Experience in monitoring activity in underlying markets to capture relevant corporate events
* Able to demonstrate practical mastery of handling complex corporate actions
* Experience in making presentations for complex corporate actions with proposed implementation to senior decision\-making Committees
* Handle client queries related to corporate actions and Equity Benchmark methodology
* A degree in quantitative discipline (e.g., BE, BTech, MS in Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, or Economics).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly. Experience in writing marketing materials or trade ideas for broad distribution is a plus.
* Exceptional attention to detail.


**Complementary Skills**
* Experience in EU/EMEA markets, with active involvement in strategic decision\-making for complex corporate event implementations.
* Market knowledge on Index rebalances, Funds, ETFs, and mechanisms
* Experience or progress towards gaining proficiency in Python


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.

description:
**About Company:** 




 BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. Its a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart.
 



 BDO India Services Private Limited (or BDO India) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





**Experience** 



* 7\+ years of overall experience in data management, MDM, data architecture
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Master Data Management experience
* Strong hands\-on experience with Profisee MDM is mandatory
* Prior experience reviewing, troubleshooting, stabilising or optimizing an existing Profisee implementation is highly desirable



  





**Required Technical Experience** 




**Mandatory:** 



* Hands\-on Profisee implementation experience
* Experience configuring and troubleshooting Profisee
* Strong understanding of Profisee architecture and implementation patterns
* Experience with Profisee data models, matching, merging, survivorship and workflows
* Experience analysing Profisee integrations and downstream data flows
* Strong understanding of MDM data quality and governance
* Experience working with complex enterprise integration landscapes



**Desirable:** 



* Azure / Microsoft Fabric / Microsoft Purview experience
* Experience with APIs and integration platforms
* Experience with ERP/CRM environments such as SAP, Salesforce, Oracle or similar
* Experience with data stewardship and operating\-model design
* Experience conducting MDM health checks, architecture reviews or implementation assessments



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 The successful candidate will:
 



**1\. Current\-State Assessment** 



* Review the existing Profisee implementation, architecture and configuration
* Understand the current MDM operating model, business processes and ownership
* Document key challenges, impacted business processes and manual workarounds
* Review how master data is created, changed, approved, mastered and distributed
* Assess the current roles and responsibilities across business, data stewardship, technology and support teams



**2\. Profisee Implementation Review** 



* Assess whether the Profisee implementation is appropriately designed for the organisation's business requirements
* Identify areas of unnecessary complexity, over\-engineering or configuration that may be contributing to operational issues
* Review Profisee data models, entities, attributes, relationships and hierarchies
* Review matching, merging and survivorship configuration
* Review workflows, stewardship processes, validation rules and business rules
* Assess whether configuration follows Profisee implementation best practices
* Identify configuration/design issues that may impact data quality or downstream processing



**3\. Integration \& Data Flow Review** 



* Review the end\-to\-end integration architecture surrounding Profisee
* Trace critical data flows from source systems through Profisee to downstream applications
* Investigate issues associated with incorrect or unexpected data updates reaching downstream systems
* Assess interfaces, APIs, integration services, event/batch mechanisms and transformation logic
* Identify potential issues around data ownership, change propagation, sequencing, dependencies and error handling
* Assess monitoring, reconciliation, exception handling and support processes
* Recommend improvements to integration patterns and controls



**4\. Data Migration \& Data Quality Assessment** 



* Assess the approach used to migrate data into Profisee
* Evaluate the organisation's confidence in migrated master data
* Identify gaps in reconciliation, validation and data\-quality controls
* Review DQ rules, thresholds and validation logic
* Assess whether current DQ controls are overly restrictive or generating unnecessary operational effort
* Recommend a pragmatic approach to balancing data quality, business usability and operational efficiency

The ideal candidate should have a demonstrated track record of growing an analytics business through new wins, account expansion, and the conversion of analytics opportunities into scalable engagements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Client Advisory and Consulting** 



* Independently lead discovery sessions, workshops, and solution conversations with senior business, analytics, data, and technology stakeholders.
* Understand the client's business priorities, operating context, analytics maturity, and decision\-making challenges.
* Translate ambiguous requirements into clearly defined analytics opportunities, solutions, and transformation roadmaps.
* Bring relevant industry perspectives, benchmarks, leading practices, and analytics and AI use cases into client conversations.
* Develop executive\-level POVs, recommendations, and client\-ready narratives, while building relationships with existing and new stakeholders.



**2\. Analytics Presales and Sales Support** 



* Partner with sales and account teams across the opportunity lifecycle, from qualification and discovery through solutioning, proposal development, presentation, negotiation, and closure.
* Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs, proactive proposals, and strategic analytics pursuits.
* Personally develop solution storylines, proposals, presentations, operating models, roadmaps, effort estimates, and value propositions.
* Lead capability presentations, demos, solution workshops, and senior client meetings as the analytics subject\-matter leader.
* Ensure proposed solutions are differentiated, practical, scalable, commercially viable, and linked to measurable business outcomes.



**3\. Account Mining and Revenue Growth** 



* Develop analytics growth plans for priority accounts in collaboration with account and delivery leaders.
* Identify whitespace and adjacent opportunities based on current engagements, stakeholder priorities, and the client's business agenda.
* Build relationships with new functions and decision\-makers beyond the current scope of engagement.
* Convert client needs and account insights into qualified opportunities, pursuit plans, and actionable next steps.
* Independently drive selected opportunities and contribute directly to analytics pipeline, new wins, account expansion, and revenue growth.



**4\. Solutioning and Commercial Shaping** 



* Structure analytics solutions with clearly defined outcomes, workstreams, data requirements, methods, deliverables, governance, and adoption plans.
* Shape integrated solutions spanning business consulting, data engineering, BI, advanced analytics, data science, machine learning, GenAI, and agentic AI.

* Define delivery models, team structures, estimates, timelines, assumptions, risks, and commercial options.

* Bring an engagement management perspective to ensure continuity between presales commitments and delivery outcomes.

* Partner with delivery leaders to address risks, refine solution direction, and maintain alignment with client expectations.
* Ensure analytical outputs are embedded into business decisions and workflows rather than delivered as standalone models or dashboards.

**6\. COE and Capability Development** 



* Guide COE teams supporting solutioning, consulting, demos, accelerators, and market\-facing collateral.

 Must Have

title: BPA Analyst II, Pet
description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The future of food will be created by those who best anticipate evolving consumer behavior. Insights and Analytics (I\&A) collects, curates, and combines data, human behavior understanding, and empathy to achieve competitive advantage for General Mills.
   

  

 Our mission in I\&A ‘globally’ is to be the spark that ignites growth acceleration, connecting insights and analytics to drive action.
   

  

 We drive business growth through a deep understanding of our consumers and our markets. Our goal is to illuminate growth opportunities and guide teams to activate behind them through consumer\-led strategies and ideas.
   

  

 I\&A Mumbai is an extension of General Mills I\&A global organization, working closely with Growth Analytics \& Foresights central teams, and all our GMI business segments i.e. North America Retail, Pet, International and North America Food Service, along with the CPW business (GMI’s JV with Nestle). We are a young and dynamic team of \~100 and growing, with research, data, and analytical skills, with the unique opportunity to shape and scale capabilities across our global organization.
   

  

 The Business Performance Analytics(BPA) teams work on market insights and business analytics for different business units within GMI segments. This team leverages a variety of data sources (Point of Sale, Consumer Panel, Analytics outputs, Numerator, Luminate, etc.) to provide insights around critical business questions ranging from Brand and Category deep\-dives, Driver analysis, Innovation, Macro factor impact, Consumer segmentation and Pricing and promo impact. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring that General Mills succeeds in an ever evolving market environment.
   

  

 We are hiring for an Analyst II for our Pet business for the North America region. The Analyst II should be a strong analytical professional with expertise in utilizing data, particularly POS and Panel data, to address critical business questions and generate actionable insights. The candidate should demonstrate the ability to conduct rigorous analysis, translate findings into clear business recommendations, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across the organization to support business objectives.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Insights \& Analytics**
* Approach problems in a structured manner and integrate knowledge of tools and techniques and apply these appropriately to the analysis of projects to deliver meaningful insights/solutions.
* Responsible for weekly Narrative and supports forums like MBR, BU MBR and others with timely, brand\-specific analytics.
* Responsible for monthly Market performance reporting to the wider team, including deep dives/analysis into share movements.
* Evaluate diverse data sources, including POS data, Panel Data, and Consumption Data, synthesizing this information to provide detailed analysis and insights, focusing on delivering the complete story rather than just data points.


**SME for OU/Brand/Region**
* Act as a POC/SME for the given Operating Unit/ Brand / Regional specialist for Global Markets. Should be able to identify the micro and macro trends and other economic trends affecting the buyer behavior.
* Proactively identify key opportunities for Brand/Region and communicate key findings and provide actionable insights.
* Partner with segment I\&A counterparts to share insights, further storytelling, and drive growth
* Translate business question into research question and apply appropriate methodology/ data/ analytic approach to answer the same.
* Mentor junior team members on projects and usage of various tools and data sets.


**Stakeholder management**
* Lead projects with high levels of accountability and ownership, effectively managing conversations and providing regular updates to stakeholders.
* Regularly evaluate business performance and come up with analysis ideas to proactively address business’ concerns.


**Operational Excellence**
* Be agile and adapt to dynamic business/team environment and continuously work to deliver on priorities.
* Handle huge data sets, navigate through multiple capabilities and deliver consistent results.
* Work effectively in a team spread across geographies and capabilities.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Minimum 4\-6 Years of experience in working with Scanner databases like IRI or Nielsen RMS. Experience/ understanding of Panel data is desirable but not mandatory.
* Bachelors/Masters degree in Business/ Statics/Economics


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in FMCG/ CPG domain is preferable
* Strong verbal, written communication skills with the ability to express difficult concepts in simple terms.
* Expert in Excel/PPT and using POS tools (Nielsen, IRI, Costco, Luminate etc.)
* Exceptional analytical, organizational/prioritization and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience of SQL, Power BI, Tableau will be an added advantage.


**ELIGIBILITY**
 Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Lead-Fraud Reporting
description:
**Job Requirements**
 About the Role
   

  

 The Lead – Fraud Reporting is responsible for preventing fraud during transactions by collaborating with the Fraud Monitoring Committee, Audit, Compliance, Branch Banking, Retail and Wholesale Operations teams. The role is critical in mitigating organizational, reputational, and financial risks to IDFC Bank and its brand image. The role entails accountability for fraud detection and solutioning for Retail Liabilities products, investigating and reporting frauds during electronic transfers. The role bearer also serves as the Nodal Officer for fraud returns to the RBI and plays a vital role in ensuring the smooth functioning of the bank while helping achieve its larger organizational objectives.

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Conduct diligent and rigorous 24x7 monitoring, reviews, and evaluations of mobile and internet banking services to limit customer liability.
* Ensure timely and accurate fraud reporting to appropriate authorities and regulatory bodies in adherence to regulations.
* Spearhead the early warning system to identify red flag accounts and provision losses.
* Lead fraud investigations based on logged incidents and conduct regular sampling checks to prevent potential fraud.
* Update the Central Fraud Repository and leverage it to recommend further measures for fraud spotting and mitigation.
* Investigate and report fraud instances including robberies or burglaries for branch and rural banking services.
* Collaborate with law enforcement agencies and police authorities to mitigate organizational and reputational risks.
* Partner with the Product team to recommend changes to products and policies to reduce fraud cases.
* Establish a risk management culture and harmonized frameworks across business and product teams.
* Oversee implementation of risk management policies, procedures, and controls ensuring regulatory and internal compliance.
* Design and deploy customer fraud awareness campaigns and initiatives regarding fraudulent activities such as skimming and phishing.
* Develop and maintain effective business relationships with all relevant external and internal entities.

* Mentor and coach senior team members to instill customer centricity, innovation, compliance, and integrity.
* Create an environment for constant innovation and bottom\-up sharing of ideas.
* Attract and retain best\-in\-class talent for key roles within the reporting structure.
* Monitor key parameters such as employee productivity, hiring quality, and attrition rates and implement necessary improvements.

 Education
   

  

* Graduate – Any
* Postgraduate – MBA in Finance


**Experience**
* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience.

* Strong understanding of fraud detection and prevention strategies.

* Leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Strong governance and compliance orientation.

title: WCR Portfolio Analytics - Associate
description:
**Job Description**
 As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expert judgement to solve real\-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best\-in\-class.
   

  

 As a valued member of the Wholesale CRE Portfolio Analytics team, you will be responsible for the research and evaluation of commercial real estate market trends and economic impacts on a \>$200 billion CRE portfolio.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Evaluate CRE data including portfolio concentrations, client and property financials, appraisal, macro\-economic data, and real estate market trends and assess the impacts on loan performance and risk grading across all property types (including construction)
* Analyze CRE loan risk grading methodologies to identify opportunities for process optimization and more efficient decision\-making, leveraging loan characteristics, key performance metrics, and industry/sector trends. Partner with technology/production partners for any use\-case/solution deployment
* Lead thematic and portfolio research initiatives focused on identifying and analyzing emerging risk trends. This involves synthesizing data and insights to understand how these trends impact industry dynamics and credit risk, thereby informing the development of proactive risk management strategies
* Utilize strong Python and SQL skills to efficiently manage and manipulate large data sets. This includes performing backtesting and conducting detailed portfolio analytics to validate models and ensure the robustness of credit risk assessments.
* (Optional) Apply Large Language Model (LLM) skills to synthesize information from multiple sources, generating systematic and comprehensive reports. This capability will enhance the ability to integrate diverse data points and insights into cohesive analyses that support strategic decision\-making.
* Develop/refine Risk and Strength Assessment (RSA) factors to create analytics\-driven market and portfolio insights and indicators, enabling continuous monitoring frameworks for proactive risk identification
* Partner with modeling teams for CRE grading model back\-testing, ongoing performance monitoring
* Work in close collaboration with senior stakeholders to maintain/monitor elevated risk segmentation, identify top risks, and provide specialized analysis and review as requested


**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, or related fields.
* 3\+ years of relevant work experience is required.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint and the ability to develop proficiency in dashboard, mapping, and data visualization software (i.e. Tableau, QlikSense)
* Relevant work experience in software, programming or coding such as Alteryx, Python or SQL.
* Desire to use modern technologies as a disruptive influence within banking.
* Attentive to detail and easily adaptable.

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Business Intelligence Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Insights \& Analytics Lead (Business Intelligence) for a Series A funded Wellness Brand.
 



  





**Job Profile** 




 Your work will typically move through: Business Question \> Data \> Analysis \> Insight \> Decision \> Outcome.
 



 Knowing the difference between Fact, Inference, Hypothesis, and Unknown will be an important part of the job.
 



 Solve ambiguous business problems.\*\* Take loosely defined questions and structure them into analytical problems that can actually be investigated.
 



 Diagnose performance. Identify the underlying drivers behind important business movements rather than simply reporting the movement.
 



 Generate insights. Find patterns, relationships, exceptions, and opportunities that are not obvious from standard reporting.
 



 Challenge assumptions. Test prevailing explanations rather than accepting the first plausible narrative, including your own.
 



 Create a common fact base. Help leadership distinguish between what we know, what we believe, and what we still need to find out.
 



 Translate analysis into business language. Turn complex analysis into concise conclusions that senior leaders can understand and act upon.
 



 Support important decisions. As you build context and credibility, increasingly contribute to recommendations, experiments, and decision\-making.
 



 Build analytical systems. Develop reusable frameworks and diagnostic approaches so the organisation becomes progressively less dependent on individual intuition.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 Any Post Graduate
 



 5\-10 Years of experience
 



 Must have proven experience solving unusually difficult analytical problems
 



 You could come from Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, Business Intelligence, Growth, Product, Marketing Analytics, Operations, Revenue Management, Corporate Strategy, Finance, Founder or Chief of Staff roles, or other analytically intensive functions.
 



 You could have worked in Consumer, Technology, SaaS, E\-commerce, Q\-commerce, Fintech, Edtech, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Consulting, or something completely different.
 



 Industry experience is not a prerequisite. If you are a strong analytical thinker, we expect you to learn a new business.
 



 What we need:
 



 Analytical reasoning\- You can take a messy problem, break it down, and determine what needs to be understood.
 



 Data fluency\- You are comfortable working directly with data and can independently investigate a problem using tools such as Excel/Sheets, SQL, BI tools, or equivalent. You do not need to be a data engineer. You do need to be able to go behind a dashboard when the question requires it.
 



 Business judgment\- You understand that analysis is valuable only when it improves understanding or decisions. You naturally ask: “So what?”
 



 Intellectual independence\- You are willing to challenge an attractive explanation when the evidence does not support it.
 



 Intellectual honesty\- You are comfortable saying “I don’t know yet” and equally comfortable saying “I was wrong.”
 



 Communication\- You can take something complicated and explain it simply.
 



 What This Role Is NOT
 



 This is not primarily a MIS role, reporting role, dashboard\-building role, Tableau administration role, data engineering role, or data\-entry role. We are not looking for someone whose main contribution is producing more reports.
 



 You should be comfortable with analytical tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, SQL or equivalent, and Tableau/Power BI/Looker or similar BI platforms. Python, statistics, and experimentation capabilities are useful additions.

title: Model Risk Analyst
description:
**Job Requirements**
 Job Description
   

  

 Primary Role.
   

  

 Model risk relates to the risk of inaccurate assessment of underlying risks arising from inappropriate model development, calibration weaknesses or incorrect application of the model and includes the risk of under\-estimation or over\-estimation of risk. The models used by the Bank are being governed under Model Risk Management framework for model lifecycle. The model lifecycle involves working in all phases including development, validation, monitoring, issue identification, resolution, documentation, and governance.
   

  

 Role involves working independently overseeing the management of model risk exposures across different business. The unit maintains oversight of all the models from implementation to usage to retirement.
   

  

**Models Under Coverage**
**Expected Credit Loss (ECL) Model (IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109\):** 
 Comprehensive validation of ECL credit risk models, including thorough evaluation of model methodology, underlying assumptions, and overall design. Activities include preparing audit‑ready documentation, supporting business decision\-making, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations (RBI/Basel), and maintaining best‑in‑class coding and model development standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Independently validate PD, LGD, EAD, SICR/staging models and macro‑economic overlays for ECL (12‑month \& lifetime).
* Assess model methodology, underlying assumptions, segmentation, variable selection, calibration approaches, and forward‑looking integration.
* Conduct benchmarking, adverse selection/reject inference analysis, and model risk tiering.
* Review SICR thresholds, cure/redefault logic, overrides, and qualitative adjustments.
* Participate in initial sign‑off and periodic re‑validation of ECL models.
* Develop monitoring dashboards and performance indicators (Python/R/Power BI).
* Maintain validation code controls, data traceability, and model inventories.
* Issue management: identify gaps, raise findings, and track remediation.
* Produce high‑quality validation reports, monitoring packs, and support governance.
* Strengthen model risk frameworks and provide regulatory and best‑practice guidance.


**Technical \& Domain Skills**
* Proficiency in Python or R for ECL model development/validation.
* Strong statistical skills.
* Good understanding of Basel, IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109, and model risk concepts.
* Knowledge of RBI’s draft ECL guidelines and regulatory expectations.
* Exposure to ECL modelling (PD, LGD, EAD, staging, overlays).


**Behavioural Skills**
* Ability to work independently on complex problems from solution to implementation.
* Eagerness to learn continuously and work on new domains / problems.
* Ability to undertake research and come out with solution for problems.
* Upholding ethical standards and maintaining objectivity in model validation and risk assessments


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 2\-5 years of experience in model validation, quantitative risk, or financial modelling, preferably within the IFRS 9\.
* Postgraduate degree such as MBA, master’s in science/mathematics, CA, Statistics or Economics.
* Professional certifications preferred: FRM, PRM, CFA.

title: Manager - Strategic Initiatives
description:
**Role Details:** 




  





 The Manager – Strategic Initiatives will be responsible for driving enterprise platform initiatives, strategic transformation and cross functional product delivery across the Consumer Banking business. The role will work closely with business leaders across Retail Assets, Liabilities, Wealth, Branch Banking, Digital Banking, Operations, Marketing, and Analytics to identify growth opportunities, improve customer experiences, enhance business performance, and drive execution of strategic priorities.
 



 The incumbent will own strategy formulation, business performance management, project execution, market analysis, and governance of high\-priority initiatives. Additionally, the role drives operational automation using AI tools and aligns technology, product and other units of Consumer Banking.
 



 The role requires strong analytical capabilities, structured problem\-solving skills, stakeholder management, digital consumer business thinking, and the ability to convert strategic objectives into actionable outcomes.
 



  





  





 1\. Strategic Planning \& Business Performance
 


* Support the development and execution of strategic priorities for the Consumer Banking business.
* Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking, and business analysis to identify growth opportunities and improvement areas.
* Assess opportunities for partnerships, new propositions, and customer experience enhancements.
* Assist leadership in translating strategic priorities into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
* Track key business metrics and support periodic business reviews.



  





 2\. Strategic Initiatives \& Transformation
 


* Drive strategic projects focused on customer acquisition, customer engagement, portfolio growth, customer experience enhancement, and productivity improvement.
* Support business transformation initiatives across Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Deposits, Lending, and Digital Channels.
* Lead horizontal platform initiatives cutting across Retail Assets, Liabilities, Wealth and Digital Banking
* Monitor initiative progress and track realization of business benefits.



  





 3\. Product \& Program Governance
 


* Manage end\-to\-end execution of assigned strategic initiatives from planning through implementation.
* Establish project plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
* Facilitate governance forums, working groups, and leadership reviews.
* Establish real\-time LPI tracking, telemetry and executive dashboards to monitor adoption, platform performance and business value realization.



  





 4\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Partner with Product, Digital, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, and Analytics teams to drive execution of strategic initiatives.
* Build strong relationships across multiple business functions.



  





 5\. AI driven Research, Analysis \& Automation
 


* Analyse business performance, customer behaviour, process efficiency, and channel effectiveness to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and develop recommendations to address business challenges.
* Develop business cases, financial assessments, and impact estimates for strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate new business opportunities and support leadership decision\-making through data\-driven insights.
* Natively embed generative AI tools across daily workflows for market research, unstructured data synthesis, business case modelling, etc.



  





 6\. Performance Tracking \& Executive Reporting
 


* Prepare business updates, strategic review documents, and presentations for senior leadership.
* Track initiative progress against defined objectives and KPIs.
* Highlight risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Support preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual business performance reviews.

 MBA or Post‑Graduate degree from a Tier‑1 institute.
 



  





**WORK EXPERIENCE**




 3\-5 years of experience in Strategy \& BizOps, Platform Solutions, Management Consulting, Business Transformation within banking, fintech or technology companies.
 



 Experience in driving cross\-functional products / programs and strategic initiatives.

title: Amazon AD Specialist
description:
**POSITION: Amazon AD Specialist** 




  





**Location:** 

 Borivali, Mumbai \| On\-site 
 




**Reports To:** 

 Director 
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time 
 




  





**About Us:** 




  






 Vibrant Publishers \& Learning Limited ("Vibrant Publishers") is a leading USA independent publisher of academic and test preparation books, dedicated to making learning accessible and practical. Our books are trusted by students, educators, and institutions worldwide for their clear, concise, and results\-oriented content. With a focus on simplifying complex subjects, we serve the needs of today’s learners in business, technology, and test prep. 
 




  





**Job Summary:** 




  






 We are looking for a data\-driven, analytical, and detail\-oriented Junior Amazon Ads Specialist to join our marketing team. This role involves setting up, managing, and optimizing pay\-per\-click (PPC) campaigns inside the Amazon Advertising Console to boost the visibility and sales of our book catalog. The ideal candidate has a strong grasp of e\-commerce metrics and can translate search data into profitable advertising strategies. 
 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**A. Campaign Setup \& Management:** 



* Launch, structure, and maintain Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns for our digital and print titles (Kindle, paperbacks, hardcovers).
* Monitor daily ad spend and track budgets across different book categories to ensure optimal distribution.
* Optimize keyword bids, product targeting, and category placements to maintain a healthy Advertising Cost of Sales (ACoS) and Total Advertising Cost of Sales (TACoS).



**B. Keyword Mining \& Market Research:** 



* Perform continuous keyword research, competitor analysis, and backend search term harvesting using tools like Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Publisher Rocket.
* Routinely identify and isolate non\-converting search terms to add as negative keywords, minimizing wasted ad spend.
* Analyze trends in test preparation and academic book searches to capitalize on high\-intent seasonal traffic.



**C. Analytics \& Performance Reporting:** 



* Extract and interpret daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports using advanced Amazon metrics (CTR, CPC, CVR, and ROAS).
* Prepare structured performance sheets to update management on the ROI of new book launches and backlist catalogs.
* Collaborate with the design and editorial teams to align ad keywords with optimized book descriptions, A\+ content, and cover messaging.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* Experience: 1 to 2 years of hands\-on experience directly managing campaigns within the Amazon Advertising Console.
* Freshers can catch up.
* Technical Skills: Strong data interpretation abilities with proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables).
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong mathematical mindset for managing budgets.
* Basic understanding of how Amazon’s A9 algorithm influences book search results and metadata optimization.
* Good communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* Eager to earn or maintain professional certifications in relevant skills such as Amazon Sponsored Ads, Amazon Retail, or Advanced Digital Marketing.



  





**What We Offer:** 




  




* Competitive monthly salary in the range of ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 (in\-hand) based on experience and qualifications.
* Opportunity to work with a dynamic and growing team in the educational publishing industry.
* Exposure to international markets and the chance to manage global ad portfolios.
* Professional development opportunities and support for skill certifications.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and growth\-oriented work environment.

title: Senior Analyst - Business Operations
description:
****The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance****
**At CoinDCX, our mission is clear \- to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.** 
**As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.** 
**We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.** 
**If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.**
**About The Role**
**This isn’t a typical Operations role.** 
**As a Business Operations Analyst, you will be at the backbone of CoinDCX’s financial engine — ensuring that every deposit, withdrawal, reconciliation, and operational workflow runs with precision and integrity.** 
**You will operate at the intersection of Payments, Risk, Finance, and Product — building systems that scale safely in a high\-growth, regulated environment. Your work will directly influence user trust, financial accuracy, and operational excellence across millions of transactions.**
****What You’ll Do****
****Drive Payment Operations Excellence****
* Own end\-to\-end processing of deposits, withdrawals, and refunds with high accuracy and SLA adherence
* Monitor transaction flows across banks and payment gateways to ensure seamless user experience
* Proactively identify and resolve payment bottlenecks before they escalate


****Build Strong Reconciliation \& Control Systems****
* Perform daily reconciliations across bank statements, gateways, and internal ledgers
* Investigate discrepancies and drive resolution within defined SLAs
* Maintain structured audit trails and reconciliation trackers to ensure financial accuracy


****Strengthen Risk \& Compliance Processes****
* Support document onboarding and verification workflows
* Ensure strict adherence to SOPs, regulatory standards, and internal controls
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation and compliance records


****Improve Processes \& Scale Systems****
* Drive process improvements to enhance speed, accuracy, and scalability
* Partner with Product and Tech teams to support automation initiatives
* Prepare structured MIS reports and dashboards to enable data\-driven decision\-making


****You’ll Excel in This Role If You****
* Think in systems and obsess over accuracy and controls
* Thrive in high\-volume, high\-velocity operational environments
* Have strong analytical skills and can break down complex transaction flows
* Bring precision and structure to ambiguous operational challenges
* Communicate clearly across Finance, Risk, Product, and Support teams
* Have a bias for action and solve problems before they grow
* Are comfortable working rotational or night shifts when business requires


****You’ll Know You’re Winning When (First 6 Months)****
* You’re independently managing high\-volume payment operations with \>99% accuracy
* Reconciliation gaps are identified and resolved proactively within SLA timelines
* You’ve implemented at least 1–2 process improvements that reduce manual effort or error rates
* Your MIS reports are being relied upon by Finance and Ops leadership for decision\-making
* Audit readiness and compliance documentation are consistently maintained


****Hiring Process****
 Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem\-solving
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best


****Where We Work****
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
   

  

 With this belief, we operate as a work\-from\-office organisation. This role is based out of our
 **Mumbai** 
 office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
   

  

****Perks That Empower You****
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities


****Ready to Build What’s Next?****
 If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high\-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
   

  

 Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialised businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients.  Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work.  Position Purpose
   

  

 The Data Architect is to support the work for ensuring that systems are designed, upgraded, managed, de\-commissioned and archived in compliance with data policy across the full data life cycle. This includes complying with the data strategy and undertaking the design of data models and supporting the management of metadata.  The Analytics \& Data (A\&D) organization is a key growth area within Morgan Stanley’s Wealth Management Division, playing a critical role in the execution of the wider Wealth Management strategy. The use of analytics and data will be a key driver in accelerating growth across all client segments, enabling data\-driven decision making and delivering the best client experience.

 Analyst / Associate role to join our Analytics \& Data organization in the NNA Analytics and Insights team function which is responsible for Net New Assets (NNA) reporting, forecasting and insights on the key drivers of NNA \- the most important and visible metric for the WM business.
   

  

 The candidate will be responsible for the ongoing distribution of multiple various reports to senior management and stakeholders, engaging teams across the organization to help with consolidating and streamlining NNA reporting. Additionally, you will help with determining insights on NNA forecasting and analyzing competitor flows by investigating additional analytical or predictive use\-cases from existing data.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Key responsibilities will include but will not be limited to the following:
   

  

* Assist in supporting A\&D NNA reporting across multiple projects and stakeholders.

description:
**Company Description** 




 Apollo Finvest is a non\-banking financial company (NBFC) listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange that powers digital lending for businesses and their customers. Positioned as the “AWS for Lending,” the company provides an NBFC license, capital, and a plug\-and\-play technology stack to launch digital loan products in under 48 hours.
 



  





 Now, we’re scaling Apollo’s lending business as well as Apollo Cash, our digital personal loan app. Apollo Cash is a 100% digital, branchless personal loan mobile application available on Android for retail borrowers in India.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a Collections Strategy Analyst (2\-6 years of experience) to support collections strategy, performance tracking, reporting, and day\-to\-day operational execution. The role requires someone who can work with data, understand portfolio movement, monitor repayment trends, and help improve collections outcomes through timely insights and structured follow\-ups.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities\-** 




**Collections Performance \& Analytics:** 




 • Monitor portfolio performance across pre\-due and delinquent buckets to identify repayment trends, risk areas, and improvement opportunities.
 



 • Prepare regular MIS reports, dashboards, and performance trackers for internal reviews and business updates.
 



 • Analyze collection efficiency, overdue movement, repayment behavior, and agency\-wise performance using Excel, SQL, Google Sheets, Metabase, or other BI tools.
 



  





**Process, Automation \& Strategy Support:** 




 • Identify process gaps, reporting gaps, and operational inefficiencies within collections workflows.
 



 • Support improvements in SOPs, campaign journeys, reporting formats, agency processes, and daily execution routines.
 



 • Assist in automating recurring reports, trackers, mailers, and other operational workflows wherever required.
 



  





**Agency Coordination \& Performance Management:** 




 • Coordinate with external collection agencies for allocation tracking, daily follow ups, performance reviews, and operational support.
 



 • Track agency productivity, collection outcomes, and key performance indicators to highlight gaps and improvement areas.
 



 • Maintain regular communication with agency partners to ensure execution discipline, target alignment, and process adherence.
 



  





**Borrower Communication \& Escalation Support:** 




 • Assist in designing and executing borrower communication campaigns across relevant channels such as SMS, WhatsApp, IVR, email, and calls.
 



 • Support borrower escalation handling by reviewing account\-level details, repayment history, and available supporting information.
 



  





**Compliance \& Stakeholder Alignment:** 




 • Ensure borrower communication, agency coordination, and collections activities are aligned with internal policies and applicable regulatory expectations.
 



 • Support documentation, audit readiness, and process adherence across collections workflows.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 • Experience in NBFC, STPL/ fintech/ digital lending.
 



 • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills, including pivots, lookups, formulas, and structured reporting.
 



 • Good understanding of collections metrics such as DPD, roll rates, flow rates, payment %, overdue amount, bounce, recovery, settlement, and agency performance.
 



 • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to convert raw data into clear insights.

 We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient professional to lead the digitalization and continuous improvement of Channel Partner processes. The role will serve as the Point of Contact (SPOC) for all Channel Partner applications and digital processes managed by the Digital Innovation team.
   

  

 The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring seamless operation of existing digital platforms, driving process automation, managing change requests, coordinating with technology partners and vendors, supporting business users, and delivering actionable analytics to enhance channel efficiency and business performance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Digital Process Ownership \& Application Management
* Act as the SPOC for all Channel Partner digital applications and processes.
* Ensure uninterrupted functioning and adoption of existing digital platforms.
* Monitor application performance, usage, data quality, and process compliance.
* Drive process automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and user experience.
* Ensure appropriate quality checks and governance mechanisms are in place.
* Data Governance \& System Integration
* Ensure Channel Partners have seamless access to all relevant application functionalities.
* Maintain data consistency and synchronization across integrated systems including:
+ Salesforce (SFDC)
+ SAP
+ Dealer Management System (DMS)

* Monitor interfaces and identify issues impacting data accuracy or business continuity.
* Business Analysis \& Change Management
* Engage with business stakeholders to understand requirements, challenges, and enhancement needs.
* Assess existing solution architecture, identify dependencies, and evaluate risks and impacts of proposed changes.
* Prepare Requirement Gathering Forms (RGFs), functional specifications, and use cases for development teams.
* Recommend optimal technical and business solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
* Change Request Lifecycle Management


 Manage end\-to\-end development and enhancement activities, including:
   

  

* Conducting stakeholder discussions, workshops, and surveys.
* Performing impact analysis and solution design.
* Preparing detailed requirement documentation.
* Coordinating with development teams for implementation.
* Executing comprehensive UAT testing and providing deployment approvals.
* Conducting post\-deployment validation and production testing.
* Preparing user manuals and knowledge portal documentation.
* Updating system documentation and object manuals.
* Publishing release notes and communication documents.
* Delivering user and business team training sessions.
* Vendor \& Stakeholder Management
* Coordinate with application vendors and technology partners for L2 support.
* Ensure timely issue resolution and service delivery.
* Collaborate closely with Channel Management teams and business users.
* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs.
* User Support \& Issue Resolution
* Drive resolution of user issues received through:
+ Emails
+ Salesforce feedback channels

* Work with Channel Management teams and vendors to ensure effective closure of incidents.
* Support administrators in resolving platform\-related issues.
* Analytics \& Performance Monitoring
* Develop and publish dashboards and reports on platform usage and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Generate data\-driven insights to improve platform adoption and business outcomes.
* Utilize analytical tools, AI capabilities, and Microsoft Office applications to drive decision\-making.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement through trend analysis.


**Functional Skills**
**Required Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong understanding of Channel Partner Management processes.
* Experience in Dealer Management Systems (DMS).
* Knowledge \& experience of process automation and digital transformation initiatives.
* Strong testing, UAT management, and release governance capabilities.
* Data analysis and reporting expertise.


**Technical Skills**
* Working knowledge of Salesforce (SFDC) is mandatory.
* Understanding of SAP integrations and enterprise systems.
* Experience with digital platforms, workflows, and system interfaces.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled productivity and analytics tools.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
* Problem\-solving and analytical mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and cross\-functional teams.
* Customer\-centric and process\-oriented approach.


**Qualification**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* MBA or relevant certification in Digital Transformation, Business Analysis, or Project Management will be an added advantage.


**Experience Required**
**Mandatory**
* 5\-8 years of experience in managing and supporting Channel Partner operations.
* Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end management of a Dealer Management System (DMS).


**Preferred**
* Experience working with Salesforce (SFDC), SAP, and integrated enterprise applications.
* Exposure to digital transformation, process automation, and business analytics projects.
* Experience managing vendors and cross\-functional business stakeholders.

* Lead meaningful projects with direct impact on how we deliver technology solutions
* Collaborative, growth\-focused culture that invests in your professional development
* Opportunities for certifications, training, and career advancement
* Flexible work options that prioritize work\-life balance
